definition: when you soak and wash your body in a tub
description: A short montage of things being washed. First two hands scrub a white plate with a sponge under a running kitchen tap. Then a jet of water sprays the front of a dark car on a driveway. Then a hand lifts a pale shirt out of a big metal tub filled with white suds. Then a woman kneels on a lawn laughing while she washes a golden retriever sitting in a large grey plastic tub of water. Finally a group of people soap up cars at a car wash in a car park.
